subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Shyam approached an leading psychologist for his treatment of anxiety and depression.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. an leading psychologist contains an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **“an”** is incorrectly used before the adjective “leading.”
 
• The article **“an”** is used before words that start with a vowel sound, whereas **“leading”** begins with a consonant sound.
 
• The correct article to use in this case is **“a.”**

Correct sentence: *Shyam approached **a leading psychologist** for his treatment of anxiety and depression.*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Articles:**
 
 
• **A:** Used before words starting with consonant sounds (e.g., a book, a cat).
 
• **An:** Used before words starting with vowel sounds (e.g., an apple, an hour).
 
 
 
• **Common Errors:**
 
 
• Using “an” before words with consonant sounds.
 
• Using “a” before words with vowel sounds.
